checks: Official raw checksum/bytes, original feature hash, raw entry/future timestamp and midpoint identity, exact coarse-label parity, and save/reload identity. Three unit tests cover boundary ties, symmetry, arbitrary precision, probability aggregation and posterior inversion.

research_basis.scope: Histogram distribution learning may aid optimization; our hard exact bins are a distinct experiment, not a reproduction of the Gaussian histogram-loss method.
Loss formulation can affect learned features; the source does not establish financial forecasting gains.

storage: Separate immutable target-only parquet files; no forecast feature file is edited. No future-target column may enter a forecast input matrix.
target_definition: Same raw first quote at or after decision+100ms and decision+5100ms. With exact decimal D=future_bid+future_ask-entry_bid-entry_ask and T=max(entry_ask-entry_bid,2*minimum_tick), radius is zero at D=0, one at 0<abs(D)<=T, two at T<abs(D)<=2T, three at 2T<abs(D)<=4T, four above4T. Bin=4+sign(D)*radius. Grouping bins0:3,3:6,6:9 must exactly reproduce every frozen down/neutral/up label.
